entries.name: Broad Jump — two linked projections, final stick
entries.sourceName: Broad Jump — two linked projections, final stick
entries.instruction: Main forward leg drive repeated once after accepting the first landing. Each round is exactly two jumps: first from a controlled dip, receive with both feet, then make one modest forward jump without an extra bounce; hold the second landing 2 s. Keep distances small and both receptions controlled. Recovery: 90 s between complete set rounds; 90 s before the next exercise/section Use instead: two separate broad jumps with a 15 s reset per round if the first reception is not organized; do not add attempts.
